authority.assignmentOwner: Kungfu Native Assignment and Work Control over native Fact and Episode authority
authority.dogfoodOwner: kungfu.dogfood-feedback Profile over native Fact Library and Episode authority
authority.publicationOwner: protected Git projection of already settled native evidence
authority.rule: The composition preserves and verifies owner roots; external coordinator records, Shifu state, Git refs, caches, and publication coordinates remain rebuildable pointers and never become semantic authority.

exitComposition.singularity: Every member delegates to its declared owner verifier. The Exit manifest inventories roots and capabilities only.

relations.successor: verified successor manifests whose parentCutRoots contain primaryCutRoot

projectCutIdentity.publication: Each retained kungfu.settlement-publication.manifest/v1 verifies its manifestRoot and selects at least one bundled Cut. Publication never decides Work completion.
projectCutIdentity.loss: Project Cut omissions, conflicts, and unknowns are retained exactly; a thin member remains inventory-only and degraded.

projectionBoundaries.surface: Shifu Assignment state and publication runtime state
projectionBoundaries.rebuildFrom: native Fact/Episode query plus tracked Project Cut and protected publication manifests

projectionBoundaries.surface: Git branch, worktree, and cache coordinates
projectionBoundaries.rebuildFrom: portable package roots and exact protected publication receipts

full.material: exact Project Cut/receipt bytes, successor bytes, protected publication manifests, and separately composed native Work/Dogfood authority members
full.import: validate all roots and destination bytes before any write, then materialize exact bytes into a clean project data-home layout and postflight

migration.sourceRetention: the package retains exact tracked bytes; original worktree and build cache are not recovery inputs
migration.destinationPreflight: same identity with different bytes rejects before any write
migration.idempotence: same roots and bytes return already_present
migration.successorRule: identity-changing schema or protocol evolution requires a new protocol and mapping receipt; old roots keep their original verifier

included: exact public or internal Project Cut artifacts

falsifiers: Atlas or Shifu projection claims Assignment, Dogfood, Cut, or publication semantic authority
a Project Cut member omits one of the four required roots
a successor does not name the primary Cut as a parent
a mutable branch or pull-request number substitutes for a rooted publication manifest
an unqualified Episode or owner receipt is admitted as protected success
an absolute private path enters the portable member
a thin member materializes or claims continuation
recovery requires the original worktree, build cache, Atlas card, or Shifu runtime projection
nonClaims: No real user home is read, migrated, or garbage-collected by qualification.
No physical-media durability, backup, replication, or distributed consensus guarantee is made.
No installed Product, cross-platform release, or public support window is qualified by this source adapter.
